slots.role_line: Data and Business Analyst in the Outsourcing and Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) department at [company], a financial institution
slots.responsibilities: data analysis and reporting on outsourcing and third-party risk; outsourcing register and DORA Register of Information (ICT third-party providers); data quality checks; business requirements and process analysis for TPRM processes and tools; support for due diligence, risk and criticality assessments, contract and SLA monitoring, and exit plans; dashboards and reports for management, risk committees and the regulator
slots.ongoing_topics: [e.g. DORA Register of Information update and submission, annual outsourcing review, vendor risk assessments]
slots.tools: [e.g. Excel, Power BI, SQL, GRC tool]
slots.stakeholders: [manager, Head of Outsourcing & TPRM], [team members], business owners of outsourced services, Procurement, Legal, Compliance, Information Security, Operational Risk, Internal Audit, Group TPRM, NBS (National Bank of Slovakia, regulator), key vendors: [names]
slots.search_signals: data, report and analysis requests; register updates; requirement reviews and approvals; audit and regulatory requests; contract renewals, expiries and vendor incidents
slots.action_verbs: reply, provide data or analysis, update a register, clarify or review requirements, decide, attend, or escalate
slots.fyi_risk_examples: data error in a report, audit or regulatory request, vendor incident, contract about to expire
slots.urgency_signals: explicit deadline, regulatory or committee reporting date, meeting soon, repeated reminders, sender waiting more than 3 days
slots.impact_areas: DORA or regulatory reporting, audit, critical or important function, data quality in management or regulatory reports, contract expiry, vendor incident
slots.ownership_rule: only Jana has the data or knowledge = 5; easy to hand over = 1
slots.next_step_options: reply, deliver data or analysis, update the register, clarify the requirement, schedule a meeting, escalate to the manager, or close
slots.solution_guidance: For data or report requests, name the likely data source, the analysis steps, and the open questions for the requester (scope, period, format, deadline).
slots.draft_extra: when giving data, state source and as-of date;
slots.discretion_rule: Handle contract terms, vendor pricing and personal data discreetly: summarize only what Jana needs to act.

description: Prejde moje pracovné maily za posledných 7 dní, vyberie 10 najdôležitejších požiadaviek z oblasti outsourcingu a TPRM, ktoré vyžadujú moju akciu, navrhne riešenie a pripraví drafty odpovedí. Funguje v Microsoft 365 Copilot.
conversation_starters: Priprav mi top 10 mailov za posledný týždeň, ktoré vyžadujú moju akciu.
Aké požiadavky na dáta alebo reporty mám otvorené a s akým termínom?
Priprav drafty odpovedí k trom najdôležitejším mailom.
Sú tam požiadavky auditu, regulátora alebo incidenty dodávateľov?
